description: This file defines classes and interfaces for a QoS-aware scheduler policy in a cellular network simulation or implementation, including traffic history management, rate estimation, and scheduling priorities.

classes.name: ue_history_repository
classes.description: Manages historical traffic data for UEs, including UL and DL average rates.

classes.name: ue_history_repository::ue_history
classes.description: Represents traffic history for a single UE, providing access to average UL and DL rates.

classes.name: rate_estimator
classes.description: Estimates maximum transport block sizes for UL and DL based on current channel conditions.

classes.name: scheduler_time_qos
classes.description: Implements a time-domain QoS-aware scheduling policy for UEs, considering traffic history and QoS parameters.

methods.name: ue_history_repository::add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE to the traffic history repository.

methods.name: ue_history_repository::rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the traffic history repository.

methods.name: ue_history_repository::save_dl_newtx_grants
methods.description: Stores new DL transmission grants for UEs.

methods.name: ue_history_repository::save_ul_newtx_grants
methods.description: Stores new UL transmission grants for UEs.

methods.name: rate_estimator::estimate_max_dl_tbs
methods.description: Estimates maximum DL transport block size for a UE.

methods.name: rate_estimator::estimate_max_ul_tbs
methods.description: Estimates maximum UL transport block size for a UE.

methods.name: scheduler_time_qos::compute_dl_prio
methods.description: Calculates DL scheduling priority based on QoS and fairness.

methods.name: scheduler_time_qos::compute_ul_prio
methods.description: Calculates UL scheduling priority based on fairness.
